NICL has announced 200 Graduate Apprentice training seats across 14 states. Online applications are accepted from 4 to 18 November 2026. Regular, full-time graduation is mandatory. The qualification and age cut-off date is 1 April 2026. The age limit is 21 to 30 years, with applicable relaxation. Postgraduate degree holders are not eligible. Candidates with previous apprenticeship training are ineligible. Applicants with at least one year of work experience as on the cut-off date are ineligible. Candidates must maintain a 100% complete NATS profile. Only one state can be selected for apprenticeship engagement. Shortlisting is based on graduation percentage. No separate written examination is specified. Graduation marks must be entered accurately in the NATS profile. Document verification instructions will be communicated by registered email. The monthly stipend is Rs. 15,000. The training duration is 12 months. Apprentices are not regular NICL employees. Completing apprenticeship does not guarantee permanent employment.

content_sections.heading: NICL Graduate Apprentices Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: The six-page notification contains the complete state-wise seat distribution, graduation requirements, age limits, category-wise relaxation, selection process, stipend, NATS registration instructions, document verification procedures and apprenticeship conditions. Official Notification PDF: Download NICL Graduate Apprentices Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: NICL Graduate Apprentice Vacancy 2026 - 200 Seats
content_sections.text: National Insurance Company Limited has announced 200 apprenticeship training seats across 14 states . Assam has the highest allocation with 30 seats, followed by Gujarat with 22 seats. Vacancy Clarification: The 200 seats are provisional and may increase or decrease according to NICL's requirements. The notification provides state-wise totals but does not announce separate district-wise or category-wise numerical allocations. No. Candidates can apply for apprenticeship engagement in only one state . NICL reserves the right to allot selected candidates to any district within their chosen state based on administrative requirements. Applicants should therefore select their state carefully before submitting the application.

content_sections.heading: NICL Graduate Apprentices Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must have completed a regular, full-time graduation degree in any discipline from a university or institution recognized by AICTE, DOTE or UGC. They must have passed their qualifying examination and possessed their degree certificate by 1 April 2026. The notification includes graduation qualifications such as B.E., B.Tech., B.A., B.Sc., B.Com., BBA and BCA in its NATS application instructions. Candidates must satisfy the recognition, completion and other eligibility conditions. The official notification specifically excludes the following candidates: Candidates holding a postgraduate degree. Candidates who have completed an integrated postgraduate course. Candidates who graduated from an institution not approved by AICTE, DOTE or UGC, as applicable. Candidates who have previously undergone apprenticeship training with NICL or another organization. Candidates currently undergoing apprenticeship training. Candidates whose previous apprenticeship training was terminated midway. Candidates with one year or more of work experience in a Government, public-sector or private organization as on 1 April 2026. Candidates without a fully completed NATS profile. Candidates who do not meet the prescribed age or graduation completion requirements. No. Candidates who already possess a postgraduate degree or have completed an integrated postgraduate course are expressly excluded under this notification, even if they also hold an eligible Bachelor's degree. Yes. Candidates who completed regular, full-time graduation by 1 April 2026 and meet the other eligibility conditions can apply without prior employment experience. Candidates with one year or more of work experience as on 1 April 2026 are not eligible. Those with less than one year of experience are not excluded by this particular condition but must satisfy all other prescribed requirements.

content_sections.heading: NICL Graduate Apprentice Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: The age limit is 21 to 30 years as on 1 April 2026 , with applicable upper-age relaxation for eligible reserved categories. Both dates in the notified General/EWS date-of-birth range are inclusive. The applicable relaxation is subject to Government of India guidelines and submission of valid supporting certificates.

content_sections.heading: NICL Graduate Apprentice Stipend 2026
content_sections.text: Selected apprentices will receive a fixed monthly stipend of Rs. 15,000 during the 12-month apprenticeship period. The Government component will be credited directly to the apprentice's bank account through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT), in accordance with applicable guidelines. Stipend Clarification: The Rs. 15,000 is an apprenticeship stipend, not a permanent employee salary. Apprentices are not entitled to other NICL employee allowances or benefits.

content_sections.heading: NICL Graduate Apprentice Training Duration 2026
content_sections.text: The apprenticeship period is 12 months . Selected candidates will receive practical training at the NICL office allotted within their selected state. Apprentices are entitled to one day of leave for each month of training, credited at the beginning of the following month and subject to prior approval. Unused eligible leave may be carried forward. A maximum of four days of leave may be taken at one time. Unused accumulated leave expires when the contract ends. Approved leave does not result in stipend deduction. Other absences may result in proportionate stipend deductions. No. NICL clearly states that it has no obligation to offer regular employment during or after apprenticeship training. The contract ends after 12 months, and apprentices cannot claim permanent absorption on the basis of completing the programme.

content_sections.heading: NICL Graduate Apprentices Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: The official six-page notification does not specify an application or examination fee. Candidates should complete their application through the official NATS portal and follow the instructions displayed there. They should not make payments to unverified recruitment agents or intermediaries.

content_sections.heading: NICL Graduate Apprentice Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: NATS Registration: Candidates register and complete their NATS student profile. Online Application: Eligible candidates apply for the National Insurance Company Limited apprenticeship opportunity. Merit-Based Shortlisting: BOPT (Eastern Region) shortlists candidates using graduation percentage marks. Email Intimation: Shortlisted candidates receive instructions through their registered email address. Document Verification: Candidates appear in person at the designated NICL office with original certificates and self-attested copies. Final Engagement: Selection is subject to eligibility verification, state-wise seat availability and approval of the apprenticeship contract in NATS. NICL will use the percentage of marks obtained in the qualifying graduation examination, calculated up to two decimal places . Where the university awards CGPA, OGPA or GPA, the candidate must convert the score into a percentage using the official conversion formula prescribed by that university. Important: Candidates must enter their graduation percentage in the prescribed NATS profile field. Applications without the percentage information will not be considered. If two or more candidates obtain the same graduation percentage, the older candidate will receive preference in the merit list. No written examination is mentioned in the notification. Shortlisting is based on graduation marks, followed by physical verification of original documents.

content_sections.heading: NICL Graduate Apprentices Apply Online 2026
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates can submit online applications for the 200 NICL Graduate Apprentice seats through the NATS portal from 4 November to 18 November 2026. Apply Online: NATS Apprenticeship Portal Establishment Name: NATIONAL INSURANCE COMPANY LTD NATS Enrollment / Establishment ID: EWBPNC096867 Last Date: 18 November 2026. Candidates must apply specifically against the NICL advertised vacancy. Creating a NATS student account alone is not sufficient.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for NICL Graduate Apprentices Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: The application procedure differs slightly for candidates who already have a NATS account and candidates registering for the first time. Visit the official NATS website at nats.education.gov.in . Click Student . Select Regular Student . Choose Student Registration . Complete the registration form with accurate personal, contact and educational details. Complete the NATS enrolment process. Save the generated 12-digit Enrollment Number . Log in and complete all required student profile sections. Ensure the NATS profile reaches 100% completion . Log in to the NATS portal using the registered email ID and password. Open Apply against advertised vacancies . Search for NATIONAL INSURANCE COMPANY LTD . Verify the available apprenticeship opportunity and establishment details. Select the applicable opportunity. Choose the eligible state for apprenticeship engagement. Check that your graduation details and percentage marks are entered correctly. Ensure the required certificates and supporting documents are uploaded in the NATS profile. Click Apply . Confirm that the application status displays Applied . Complete the application before 18 November 2026 . Retain the NATS Enrollment Number and application details. Important: Candidates already registered on NATS do not need to create another student account. They can log in with their existing credentials, complete their profile and apply to the NICL opportunity.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for NICL Graduate Apprentices Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applicants must upload the relevant documents clearly in their NATS student profiles. The notification identifies the following records. Applicants must ensure their name, parents' names, Aadhaar number and educational details match their certificates and identity records. The company specifically requires candidates to enter the graduation percentage in the % of marks / CGPAx10 field in the NATS portal. Candidates with CGPA-based results must use their university's prescribed percentage conversion formula. Applications without the graduation percentage will not be considered.

content_sections.heading: NICL Graduate Apprentice Document Verification 2026
content_sections.text: Shortlisted candidates must attend document verification in person at the NICL office assigned to them. The date and location will be communicated through their registered email address. Applicants must carry original certificates and self-attested photocopies supporting their age, educational qualification, identity and other eligibility claims. Travel and Accommodation: NICL will not pay TA/DA for document verification. Boarding and lodging expenses are also not admissible. Being called for document verification does not guarantee final engagement. The company will verify the details entered in NATS against the original records before approving the apprenticeship contract.

content_sections.heading: NICL Graduate Apprentice Reservation Rules 2026
content_sections.text: NICL will follow the applicable reservation guidelines under the Apprentices Act for SC, ST, OBC and PwBD candidates. OBC candidates claiming reservation must possess the prescribed Government of India Non-Creamy Layer certificate. The notification specifies that the certificate must be issued during the period from 1 April 2026 up to the date of engagement , if selected. OBC candidates belonging to the creamy layer are not entitled to OBC reservation benefits and should apply as General or General-PwBD, as applicable.

content_sections.heading: NICL Apprentice Contract and Service Conditions
content_sections.text: Selected candidates must enter into a formal apprenticeship contract with NICL, approved through the NATS portal. Apprentices are trainees and will not be treated as regular employees of NICL. Employee benefits such as PF, ESI and bonus do not apply to this apprenticeship engagement as stated in the notification. The contract normally terminates automatically after 12 months. Misconduct, false information, failure to meet eligibility conditions or prolonged unauthorized absence may lead to earlier termination. If an apprentice remains absent without authorization for more than 15 consecutive business days, NICL may issue a three-day notice by email. If no satisfactory explanation is received, the company may terminate the apprenticeship contract under the notified conditions.

content_sections.heading: Common Reasons for Rejection of NICL Apprentice Applications
content_sections.text: NATS profile is not 100% complete. Applicant does not possess an eligible regular, full-time graduation degree. Graduation was not completed by 1 April 2026. Candidate possesses a postgraduate degree or completed integrated postgraduate course. Candidate has already undergone or is undergoing apprenticeship training. Candidate has one year or more of work experience as on 1 April 2026. Graduation percentage is missing or incorrectly entered. Application details do not match original certificates. Required supporting documents are missing or illegible. Candidate fails to meet the prescribed age conditions. Application is submitted after the deadline. Candidate fails to produce the necessary original documents during verification.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NICL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 18 November 2026. Applications opened on 4 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in NICL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 200 vacancies for Graduate Apprentices.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for NICL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 18 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 21 to 30 years (as on 1 April 2026). Relaxation: SC/ST 5 years, OBC (Non-Creamy layer) 3 years, PwBD (Gen/EWS) 10 years, PwBD (SC/ST) 15 years, PwBD (OBC) 13 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Monthly stipend of Rs.15,000.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Graduation (Regular - Full time) in any discipline from a University / Institution recognized by AICTE / DOTE / UGC, passed with degree certificate as on 01.04.2026; 100% complete profile on the NATS portal.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Apply for engagement in ONE state only. Candidate must not have undergone or be pursuing apprenticeship training earlier, or been terminated from it.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Holders of a Post-Graduate Degree or Integrated Postgraduate Course. Graduates of an institution not approved by AICTE / DOTE / UGC. Candidates with one year or more of work experience as on 01.04.2026. Candidates who earlier underwent, are pursuing or were terminated from apprenticeship training.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Shortlisting by Board of Practical Training (Eastern Region) from NATS online application data, on percentage of marks in the qualifying Graduate Degree Examination. Physical verification of documents of shortlisted candidates at offices of National Insurance Co. Ltd. Contract of Apprenticeship with NICL, approved in the NATS portal. Shortlisting on percentage of marks up to two decimal places in the qualifying Graduate Degree Examination.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Apprenticeship duration 12 months. Apprentices are not employees of NICL and get no employee benefits. No obligation to offer regular employment after apprenticeship.
